title: Codelist governance (implementer-neutral)
description: registries/codelist-governance.json. Per codelist: the .gc file that carries it (absent means not shipped), its aliases, whether the Schematron/CVA enforces its value set, whether the model inlines its values as an enum in the instance-data schemas, and any ESPD profile narrowing. 'Shipped' is derived (gc present). UI use is each implementation's own decision.

gc.description: The Genericode file under ESPD-EDM/codelists/. Present means shipped.

aliases.description: Other names the list is known by (case-insensitive).

schematronValidated.description: The CVA/Schematron enforces the value set.

inlineEnum.description: The published instance-data schemas inline the values as an enum.

excludedCodes.description: Codes present in the .gc that are not valid in the ESPD context (an ESPD profile narrowing of a shared table).

externalSource.description: Where an unshipped list comes from.
